ALTER PROCEDURE BNKM.SP_InstitutionalBankingGroupList_DID
AS
BEGIN


WITH TEMP_BNKM_InstitutionalBankingGroupList AS
(
	SELECT
		BDI.fcbs_customer_id AS CustomerId
		,'IBG' AS BusinessUnit
		,BDI.INSERT_DTTM AS PeriodStartDate
		,'9999-12-31' AS PeriodEndDate
		,'CRM' AS SourceCode
		,BDI.BNK_CODE AS FinancialInstitutionId 
		,'DID' AS SourceSystemCode
		,0 AS TaskRunId
		,0 AS WorkFlowId
		,BDI.INSERT_DTTM AS InsertDttm
		--,'INSERT' AS RECORD_STATUS
		FROM BUSC.DID_IBGLIST BDI  
		WHERE BDI.ISLATEST = '1'
)

SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_InstitutionalBankingGroupList FROM TEMP_BNKM_InstitutionalBankingGroupList;

WITH TEMP_BNKM_InstitutionalBankingGroupList_SRC AS
(
	SELECT
		HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
			CustomerId
			,BusinessUnit
			--,PeriodStartDate
			--,PeriodEndDate
			,SourceCode
			,FinancialInstitutionId)) AS HASHROW
			,CustomerId --,RECORD_STATUS
	FROM #TEMP_BNKM_InstitutionalBankingGroupList --WHERE RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
)

,TEMP_BNKM_InstitutionalBankingGroupList_TGT AS
(
	SELECT
		HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
			CustomerId
			,BusinessUnit
			--,PeriodStartDate
			--,PeriodEndDate
			,SourceCode
			,FinancialInstitutionId)) AS HASHROW
			,CustomerId
	FROM BNKM.InstitutionalBankingGroupList WHERE PeriodEndDate in ('9999-12-31')
),

TEMP_BNKM_InstitutionalBankingGroupList_DELTA AS
(
	SELECT	
		SRC.HASHROW AS SRC_HR
		,TGT.HASHROW AS TGT_HR
		,ISNULL(SRC.CustomerId,TGT.CustomerId) AS CustomerId
		,CASE
			WHEN TGT.CustomerId IS NULL THEN 'INSERT'
			WHEN SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW THEN 'UPDATE'
			ELSE NULL 
		END AS RECORD_STATUS
	FROM TEMP_BNKM_InstitutionalBankingGroupList_SRC SRC
	LEFT JOIN TEMP_BNKM_InstitutionalBankingGroupList_TGT TGT
	 ON SRC.CustomerId = TGT.CustomerId
	WHERE SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW OR TGT.HASHROW IS NULL
)
--SELECT COUNT(*) CNT, RECORD_STATUS  FROM TEMP_BNKM_InstitutionalBankingGroupList_DELTA
--GROUP BY RECORD_STATUS;

SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_InstitutionalBankingGroupList_DELTA FROM TEMP_BNKM_InstitutionalBankingGroupList_DELTA;

----UPDATE RECORDS to BNKM
UPDATE TGT 
SET
PeriodEndDate = dateadd(dd,-1,getDate()) 
FROM BNKM.InstitutionalBankingGroupList TGT
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_InstitutionalBankingGroupList_DELTA DELTA ON DELTA.CustomerId = TGT.CustomerId AND DELTA.RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_InstitutionalBankingGroupList SRC ON SRC.CustomerId = TGT.CustomerId 
WHERE TGT.PeriodEndDate in ('9999-12-31')



-------------INSERT RECORDS TO BNKM
INSERT INTO BNKM.InstitutionalBankingGroupList ( 
CustomerId
,BusinessUnit
,PeriodStartDate
,PeriodEndDate
,SourceCode
,FinancialInstitutionId
,SourceSystemCode
,TaskRunId
,WorkFlowId
,InsertDttm)

SELECT 
	 SRC.CustomerId AS CustomerId
	,SRC.BusinessUnit AS BusinessUnit
	,SRC.PeriodStartDate AS PeriodStartDate
	,SRC.PeriodEndDate AS PeriodEndDate
	,SRC.SourceCode AS SourceCode
	,SRC.FinancialInstitutionId AS FinancialInstitutionId
	,'DID' AS SourceSystemCode
	,0 AS TaskRunId
	,0 AS WorkFlowId
	,SRC.InsertDttm AS InsertDttm
	--,CONVERT(DATE,CONVERT(VARCHAR,PeriodStartDate)) AS PeriodStartDate
	--,STUFF(PeriodEndDate,1,27,'20991231') AS PeriodEndDate
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_InstitutionalBankingGroupList SRC
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_InstitutionalBankingGroupList_DELTA DELTA ON  DELTA.CustomerId = SRC.CustomerId
AND DELTA.RECORD_STATUS in ('INSERT', 'UPDATE');

DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_InstitutionalBankingGroupList;
DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_InstitutionalBankingGroupList_DELTA;

END
